review_notes: I read the whole target file. It defines only `Intertwiner` (an abbrev for `Link N right left`), `component` (the corner `inr† ∘ v† ∘ inl`), `finiteColumn` (`column` applied to the components) and `compression` (`inl† ∘ finiteProjection ∘ inl`). The rest is lemmas. None of these duplicates a Mathlib concept. The bounds and adjoint facts already use Mathlib's `ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint` and `opNorm` API. `inlL`, `inrL`, `block`, `Space` and `Copies` come from other repo files (HilbertBiprod, HilbertFiniteMaps). They are not introduced here, so they are outside this file. I opened HilbertBiprod. `HilbertBiprod.Space` is `WithLp 2 (H × G)`, and `inlL`, `inrL` and `block` are built from `WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv`. Whether a Mathlib-level counterpart for these exists is not a defect of this file. `HilbertPair.lean` also defines `Space F K := WithLp 2 (F × K)`, which looks like an in-repo duplicate. That is not in the target file and not a Mathlib concept, so I did not report it. I found no evidence of a competing Mathlib concept with a concrete cost in this file.
